title: MOTION (McOSKER - LEE) relative to amending a prior Council action related to Council No. 23-0704, relative to traffic detours for the Vincent Thomas Bridge…
text:
[Council File 23-0704; CD 15]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (McOSKER - LEE) relative to amending a prior Council action related to Council No. 23-0704, relative to traffic detours for the Vincent Thomas Bridge Deck Replacement Project.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. AMEND its prior action in Council file No. 23-0704, relative to traffic detours for the Vincent Thomas Bridge Deck Replacement Project.
2. INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation, in coordination with Caltrans and the Port of Los Angeles, to expedite preparation of an emergency traffic management plan to temporarily restripe the intersection of Alameda Street and Anaheim Street to provide two right-turn lanes from Alameda Street onto eastbound Anaheim Street toward Henry Ford Avenue. The plan should identify any necessary signal and signage changes and the earliest feasible installation date to relieve congestion at this bottleneck during the bridge detour.
